title: Contrastive belief-update measurement of reward-seeking on public Qwen2.5 models
description: The paper's contrastive-SDF measurement and controls port cleanly to Qwen2.5-7B/14B, but the reported grader-following effects appear only weakly at 14B (both style and honesty gaps consistently positive at small effect size) and not at 7B, where implanted authority-preference beliefs fail to bind at behavior-preserving training doses.
